o.text: Internationalism; via Russian тип (tip), from Ancient Greek τύπος (túpos).
From Proto-Turkic *bẹńŕ (“swelling; scar, ulcer”) cognate with Turkish bez, Chuvash пӳр (pür, “pus”), etc.
From Persian شغال (šaġâl), from Sanskrit शृगाल (śṛgāla, “jackal”). Cognate with Ottoman Turkish چقال (çakal).
Calque of Persian رواج دادن (ravâj dâdan, literally “give going”).
